presets.name: Skaneateles Lakeshore
presets.note: From Skaneateles village out East Lake Road along the lake to Pork Street, over to Rickard Road and home on US 20 into the village

presets.name: Charlie Major Trail & Skaneateles Falls
presets.note: From Skaneateles down Fennell Street to the Charlie Major Nature Trail along Skaneateles Creek, through Mottville to Skaneateles Falls, back over Stump Road and the Old Seneca Turnpike

presets.name: Seneca Turnpike: Skaneateles to Marcellus
presets.note: From Skaneateles over the hills on the Old Seneca Turnpike to Marcellus, south over Bishop Hill and home along Lawrence Road, the New Seneca Turnpike and US 20

presets.name: Marcellus Falls & Nine Mile Creek
presets.note: From Marcellus village down North Street beside Nine Mile Creek to Marcellus Falls, up Falls Road and Howlett Hill Road and back down Dublin Road

presets.name: Bishop Hill Climb
presets.note: From Marcellus up South Street Road and Bishop Hill Road over the top, along Masters Road and back down Rockwell and Slate Hill Roads

presets.name: Skaneateles Lake Loop
presets.note: Round Skaneateles Lake: south on West Lake Road and NY 41A high above the west shore, round the south end at Glen Haven, and home along East Lake Road (NY 41) on the east shore

presets.name: Otisco Lake Loop
presets.note: From Amber at the north end of Otisco Lake down Otisco Valley Road on the east shore, round the south end at Otisco Valley, and back up the west side on Willowdale Road and NY 174

presets.name: Vinegar Hill & Kingston Road
presets.note: From Skaneateles out Jordan Road to Mottville, along Vinegar Hill Road above Skaneateles Creek, back up Kingston Road and home on State Street Road

presets.name: South End Climb: NY 41 & Nunnery Road
presets.note: From East Lake Road at the lake the long climb of NY 41 onto the high ground at the south end (about 530 m), across on Woodworth Road and down Nunnery Road to the lake (Ridge Road is a dead end in the map, so the loop keeps north of it)

presets.name: Spafford Highlands
presets.note: The ridge between Skaneateles and Otisco Lakes: up Willow Hill Road, along Becker Road over the top and back down Willowdale Road

presets.name: Skaneateles Creek & County Line
presets.note: From Skaneateles north on Jordan Road down the creek valley to Skaneateles Falls, across Sheldon Road and back south on County Line Road and West Lake Road

presets.name: Slate Hill & Limeledge
presets.note: From Marcellus west on Limeledge Road, down to Stump Road and back over the hills to Marcellus by Slate Hill Road

presets.name: Two Lakes Grand Tour
presets.note: The longest ride: down the west shore of Skaneateles Lake, round Glen Haven, up NY 41, over Stanton Road to Otisco Lake, up its east shore to Amber, and home by Marietta and the Cherry Valley Turnpike
